extracted.name: Cola Cake
extracted.description: This recipe uses a can of soda blended with cake mix instead of oil, water, and eggs. The cake comes out surprisingly fluffy, moist, and flavorful.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle cola-flavored carbonated beverage (such as Coke®)
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Combine cake mix and cola in a large bowl. Use a hand whisk to mix ingredients until light and smooth, about 3 minutes. Pour batter into prepared baking dish.
Bake cake in preheated oven until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes. Allow cake to cool before cutting.
